warnings.warning: The three value equations are watermark-flattened and several terms run together. The reading follows the prose, which assigns the first term to barter and the next two to trades with each currency.
The threshold formulas for mu-hat and lam-hat are badly scrambled. They are recovered from the three prose cases: accept, reject, or indifferent.
The revenue function mixes absolute values and matching terms on one line, and the derivative condition is garbled. It is read as revenue net of cost rising with acceptance.
Equation (6) prints the profit symbols and the second derivative in a scrambled order. The curvature-times-variance reading follows the convexity claim beside it.
The purchasing-power-parity rate is split across lines with misplaced subscripts. It is read as the standard ratio of gross real rates and gross inflation rates times the initial rate.
The trade-share recursion is compressed onto one line. The dependence on the previous share and the two rate changes follows the prose description of the simulation.
